concerns.text: Tasks write/map reason codes (primary_substrate_filter, ambiguous_structure, ambiguous_stereochemistry, descriptor_failure, invalid_substrate_label, missing_smiles) that do not exist in the schema's allowed_values (primary_substrate, canonicalization_error, gasteiger_convergence_error, invalid_smiles, missing_substrate_class, steric_hindrance_exceeded). No task produces ANY of the schema's sanctioned codes, so the contract's enum is entirely uncovered and T012's verification ('log rows parse against exclusion_report.schema.yaml') cannot succeed. Reconcile codes or amend the schema via a task.

FR-004 requires a KRR baseline, but model_output.schema.yaml's baselines object only permits random/linear/null and model_type has no KRR entry. T022 must record KRR in metrics.json per FR-004, yet no task updates the schema to cover it — the KRR comparison results have no contract-conformant home. Add a schema-amendment task or extend T022.

T022, T602, and T028 depend on 'already-implemented' T019/T020/T021/T024 artifacts (train.py with --max-configs and subprocess timeout, evaluate.py, tests/unit/test_collinearity.py) that have NO task body in the current tasks.md — they exist only in the 'Revision behavior' list as previously verified. A fresh implementer cannot trace the timeout mechanism or training entry point to any task; include or inline their acceptance criteria.

output.schema.yaml requires a combined output object (metrics, comparisons, shap_summary, sensitivity, vif_report, consistency) but no task produces an artifact conforming to it — the contract is orphaned. Either add a task that assembles this object (e.g., in T039) or note its retirement.

Plan Phase 0 mandates a 'Distribution Shift Check: ... check for experimental condition shifts between datasets. Exclude rows with ... unresolvable condition shifts.' No task covers the cross-dataset condition-shift check (T012 covers only unit harmonization and per-row missing values). Add this check to T012 or a dedicated task.

No task validates the cleaned output (cleaned_intermediate.csv / descriptors.csv) against dataset.schema.yaml, though the contract exists and T012/T015 validate only the exclusion log. Minor coverage gap for the dataset contract.
